title: Predatory subscription price
text: It’s very sad to witness how greedy the developers of this app have gotten. I remember when I first downloaded this app a few years ago the yearly subscription for Duolingo while it was over $50 was reasonable the way that developers think it’s appropriate to charge a subscription fee of over $120 yearly is honestly egregious. We used to be able to buy language learning programs and pay one fee and that was it. I’m honestly tired of these subscriptions that were expected to pay every year and it’s over $100. Even just this year in the in the one month that I’ve returned on the app when I got back onto Duolingo prior to activating my super trial, Duolingo was being advertised as I think it was $90 for individual and now it’s 120 a family plan is 140. It’s greedy. It’s gross practice. I would not mind paying that fee one time but to have to pay $120 a year for a digital application that could be removed at any I’m not OK with
